items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe reports no exploitation in the wild for these specific issues, but recommends applying the patch immediately.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: This emergency hotfix addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Attacks exploiting this zero-day started on September 4th, 2026, before the fix was released.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This security update resolves eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and several incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that allows attackers to switch a customer session to another account. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction, and active exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) is an unrestricted file upload flaw that could lead to privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution. It has been actively exploited to plant backdoors and inject malicious scripts into checkout pages.
